# Original resources through child traversal and captured selected edges

Ordered child traversal: ea5fd02f6f4eabc1af8763a05cd0049aef6c8f0b.
Selected-edge resources: e0b3789d77727bc341990ad1f2741b91ebe5933f.
Captured-slot resources: b1594bdf39e0a7ef018443162d2f6515ab51d384.

6d05544356118f468218205326284afee54de8d2.

## Strongest claim and exact scope

H6, SourceCurrentColdFiniteWarmCalls.constructed_node_calls, remains the
strongest end-to-end language theorem. A covered closed construction and valid
constraint-allocation history supply any prescribed finite number of modeled
node-processing rounds. The actual trace completes at sufficient fuel and
one mathematical word width selected after construction. Its inherited
payload is empty. The final available value has exactly the initial finite-
tree language for every ambient context and term under Formula/Entailment.
It does not cover arbitrary mixed calls or the full recursive driver.

The new results construct complete finite child traversal, one supported
selected edge and its captured-slot finalization from genuine current facts
and an original mixed reservation. They retain every earlier completion
receipt and add numeric Fits and a guard carrier at the SAME actual final
native caller. Valid rejection retains its completed prefix and stopping
receipt. These results do not prove whole-driver language or recursion.

The original finite schedule can use IncomingReservation.reserved_computed
to choose a sufficient mathematical width. The current caller must satisfy
its Context, Fits and guard-carrier facts at the producer's width. No caller
width conversion, host-64 capacity or practical runtime bound is proved.
Concrete solver, physical-container and host-integer correspondence,
extraction, convergence, terminal outer fallback, native Graph correspondence
and arbitrary lazy forcing remain open.

## Original cost for successive actual children

TraversalCompletion.cost [] is zero. Each original pair (incoming,bucket)
adds bucket.length+1. The count keeps duplicate entries. The mixed forecast
includes native intersection and its optional enabled Empty constructor
allocation. Empty or nonterminal child routes can use conservative steps.
The count depends on original input lists. It does not inspect a future heap.

complete_with_fragments_resources follows the old traversal induction.
Each reached head invokes ChildCompletion.complete_with_fragments_resources
ONCE. Reserved.prefix supplies that bucket's reservation. Its full returned
packet supplies the actual middle caller, cache, memos, Context, waiting and
native-index facts. The suffix seed advances by bucket.length+1.
Reserved.after_prefix supplies the remaining reservation from the original.

Full Post transports original suffix-value availability. Counter growth
transports bounds. EnumeratedOrigin and Protected transport InputsPending.
The suffix therefore runs at its actual current native and cache endpoint.
It does not restart from the original native caller or restore its memos.

A rejected head keeps its exact stopped result and actual returned caller.
Numeric growth and alphabet inclusion along the SAME schedule extend its
bounds through the unused forecast. No unused child execution or rejected
Safe fact is asserted. Successful prefixes retain fragment bounds, pending
holes and separation from protected slots through each later actual child.
The shared stable representative/native/index sums and worker maxima remain
as in the earlier proof. The result holds at all stated larger fuel bounds.

This is a direct producer induction. The resource observer alone does not
establish semantic invariants for every arbitrary cache transition in the old
universally quantified TraversalCompletion.Ranges. The new theorem does not
claim that predicate. It derives the actual completion packet without it.
complete_resources projects this new full fragment packet once.

## Cost the actual projected selected-edge inputs

SelectedEdge.cost edge scs start tries applies TraversalCompletion.cost to
EdgeInputs.children edge scs start tries. For each ordered child index, the
actual bucket is:

    descendScs index scs ++
      descendScs index (suspendedVars start tries)

The original edge projection supplies tries and residual. Both inherited and
fresh own-class entries count. Descent filters ordered lists; no duplicate
removal is introduced. The cost uses the original cache counter as start.
No later enumeration or native endpoint supplies its definition.

SelectedEdge.complete_with_fragments_resources retains the old genuine
parent availability, closedness, selected membership, Safe, realized slots,
roots, waiting, native flags, bounded/pending inputs, allowed arity and
supported projection premises. Initial Fits, the guard carrier and Reserved
at this original cost replace only the earlier future-range premise.
Unsupported annotation and arity fallback remain separate source branches.

EdgeInputs.complete constructs the actual own-class prefix and its genuine
child inputs. This changes the enumeration cache and retains the native
caller. The new traversal producer runs once from that prefix. The selected
edge retains its entire earlier Post, memos, cache facts, origins, input
pending facts, protected roots, reference preservation and fragment history.
Residual recording changes the final cache obligations and retains the
actual returned native caller and its Fits/carrier. complete_resources
projects the new full fragment producer once.

## Preserve captured-slot completion and history

CapturedEdge.complete_with_history_resources starts from the same ready
stored ordinary parent, actual decode, current Context/cache facts and
supported selected edge as the earlier producer. Its resource reservation
uses SelectedEdge.cost at the original cache counter. It invokes the new
selected-edge fragment producer ONCE.

Successful native-index finalization writes the original captured slot,
clears expansion ancestry, keeps that slot a root and retains PendingFragment.
The earlier stratification result still advances the frontier by one.
Protected other roots, enumerated origins away from the captured slot,
InputsPending and conditional pending-reference history remain intact.
The returned native caller and saved queries do not change during finalization.
The same Fits and guard carrier therefore remain valid without another mixed
forecast step. Rejection retains the selected edge's actual stopped receipt,
cache and native caller. No captured-slot write is asserted on rejection.
complete_resources projects the full new history packet once.

## Exact earlier contracts

Every old output proposition is source-equal after width specialization to
bits+2, before the appended Fits and guard-carrier fields. Counts exclude the
final newline. The retained character and UTF-8 byte counts are:

| Earlier producer | Characters | Bytes |

| Traversal complete_with_fragments | 2579 | 2691 |
| Traversal complete | 2231 | 2321 |
| SelectedEdge complete_with_fragments | 2088 | 2176 |

The exact strings and SHA256 values remain in old-contracts.json and the
six original-output files. No runtime worker or old declaration type changes.
Safe remains conditional on successful completion. The final numeric bound
is Fits. It does not supply Room for another query. Reserve the following
entry from original inputs before adding a continuation.

## Next actual integration

Carry original resources through successive native alternatives. Source
alternatives restore branch-local EnumerationState while retaining reached
native interner and query effects. Keep the original captured branch cache
where the source restores it. Thread the actual native caller and saved
query memo from each evaluated alternative into the next one.

Then include actual concrete callbacks, bounded recursive subtrees and later
siblings. The legacy ordinary Ranges uses endpoints before recursive
continuations. It does not reserve actual post-subtree endpoints. Retain
per-output Post at each emission endpoint and a separate final native Post.
Full initial-only recursive capacity and whole-driver language remain open.
Do not identify shallow branch completion with recursive subtree completion.
